It is time to catch up on an unforgettable first week in the villa, with loads of unseen action and all the best moments crammed into one jam-packed hour.
The boys and girls reflect on the previous boy who was kicked out. When two new girls arrive in the villa, tensions begin to rise between the existing groups.
Chris plays a dangerous game. Olivia prepares to pie Sam. Camilla sheds her inhibitions during a kissing challenge. Marcel and Gabby get closer.

The villa plays host to its most dramatic evening yet as Jessica's birthday party turns sour. Chris bins Chloe and Sam calls out Chris for his backstabbing behaviour. Later, Dom and Jessica escape to the hideaway.

A debate over feminism leaves a question mark over Camilla and Jonny's relationship. Will Camilla accept Jonny's apology? Meanwhile, Marcel and Gabby enjoy their first kiss and Montana and Chloe worry about their future in the villa.
The girls get twerk-tastic for a new bootylicious challenge. Could Montana be the new girl for Sam? New boy Mike shakes things up.
As the end of week two approaches, the heat is rising as the cast of young sexy singles vie for the 50,000 pound prize.
Caroline Flack presents a feast of unseen moments and the very best of last week's action from the villa, featuring plenty of flirting, fighting, romance and juicy gossip.
The impending recoupling is all anyone can talk about. The islanders play a devilish game of truth or dare. Chloe stirs up some drama between Mike and Olivia.
The recoupling leaves Olivia tearful and torn between two guys. Chris calls out Mike on his behaviour. The latest challenge leads to some saucy revelations.
The love triangle between Chris, Olivia and Mike intensifies. Jonny and Camilla show off their sexpertise. Montana has a chat with Sam, but is he really listening?
The islanders are left reeling when Caroline drops a bombshell. Mike makes a play for both Chloe and Amber. Will Olivia finally decide between Chris and Mike?

Jessica and Mike's unexpected departure leaves the islanders - especially Dom and Olivia - in shock. Gabby chats to Amber about her feelings for Marcel as Olivia and Chris get back on track. Two new arrivals look set to shake things up.
